page.overview:
Who is Reggie Burns?

is a raccoon played by Matthew Mercer for .

Reggie is a raccoon of a nervous disposition with gray and black fur. He has (apparently) survived many accidents; his artwork depicts him as having his right leg and paw wrapped in bandages, a band-aid over his muzzle, a chunk missing from his right ear, and his left eye being closed with a large scar over it. He wears a purple fedora with a pair of (presumably) race tickets sticking out of the hat band.
